python3 << 'EOF'
target="(((((((((((((((.(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).(((.....))).(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).(((.....))).(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).(((.....))).(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).(((.....))).(((((.((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).((.....)).))))).)))))))))))))))"
n=len(target)

# unit sequences from solver (verified short solves)
unit2="GCGGUCGGC"      # ((.....))
unit3="CUCAGCCCGAG"    # (((.....)))

# decomposition units (positions, 0-indexed) from analyze_target
units=[
 (22,30),(32,40),(42,50),(52,60),(62,70),
 (78,88),
 (96,104),(106,114),(116,124),(126,134),(136,144),
 (152,162),
 (170,178),(180,188),(190,198),(200,208),(210,218),
 (226,236),
 (244,252),(254,262),(264,272),(274,282),(284,292),
 (300,310),
 (318,326),(328,336),(338,346),(348,356),(358,366),
]

seq=['A']*n
for (s,e) in units:
    sub=target[s:e+1]
    u = unit2 if len(sub)==9 else unit3
    assert len(u)==e-s+1, (s,e,len(sub),len(u))
    for k,b in enumerate(u):
        seq[s+k]=b

# fill linkers / junction closing pairs with G-C
# junction closing pairs (outer stems)
jc=[(0,374),(14,388),(20,72),(94,146),(168,220),(242,294),(316,368)]
# the outermost: target[0..15) = 15 '(' , target[374..389)= 15 ')'
# closing pair at (14,374)? analyze said closing_pair@[14,374] branches=9
# Let's just verify what positions are paired in target
stack=[]; pairs=set()
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pairs.add((j,i))
